extracted.stage: Personal injury claim, funding sought for disbursements and counsel
extracted.summary: A solicitor at Garside Legal asks whether Lodestar funds a road traffic personal injury claim, seeking £65,000 for disbursements and counsel.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry, which we have received and logged. So that we can consider it properly, we would be grateful for confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the claim is proceeding, the current stage and any listed hearing dates, and the valuation of the claim together with details of any security available. It would also help to have an outline of the costs budget the £65,000 is intended to cover. Please note our funding is focused on specific product types, and a colleague will review the details before coming back to you.
